notes.notes: [p]Record all characters’ voices yourself and replace all character voices[/p][p][/p][p]Modify to allow volume adjustment[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637988/d97cab48d91e74f02bbbc72933f0428fcea11871.png"][/img][/p][p]Due to some careless work previously, Stage 4 appeared poor and incomplete. This issue has now been fixed, and Stage 4 no longer looks impoverished.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637988/8c1816b73ae6d8101137963643f3bbf2f8575576.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Open the Adjust Display Resolution dialog. The names of the hero and heroine.
notes.notes: [p]Since some players were unable to launch the game, we enabled the [b]Display Resolution Dialog[/b] feature to let players adjust the graphics settings themselves, in hopes of resolving the issue.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637988/fe254bf8ce7665ca17586e77519734ddb9403803.png"][/img]The names of the male and female protagonists have been added to the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637988/c8f054f46e1b9fd325001005dc797885731d6a95.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Tiger Boss bug fixed
notes.notes: [p]We apologize that the previous bug fix for the Tiger Boss was incomplete. This time, the issue has been fully resolved.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637988/c97909a9f0bd7295ea47bf2b9d711ae5e0475b7d.png"][/img][/p]
